title: Metadata API: GET /api/v1/meta/app?id= with an empty value ignores the filter and answers the caller's full app list
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcUWM7N73xRVd64cyAE

QA-source: #28545 · platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render · observed beside the clauses

An app read filtered by an empty `id` answers as if no filter were given. A caller who asked for one app by a name that came out blank gets every app it can see. Found by an off-clause probe and reproduced twice, once as a member and once as admin. The per-caller visibility gate runs first, so nothing leaks beyond the caller's own list. This is the same class as #27484 (a blank `$searchFields` read as absent), which was fixed.

## Reproduction (stock showcase at `eeec88d1`)
1. Sign in as admin (`admin@objectos.ai`), then `GET /api/v1/meta/app?id=` → 200 with `[showcase_app, setup, account]`.
2. Sign in as a member (for example `phone.demo@example.com`), then `GET /api/v1/meta/app?id=` → 200 with `[showcase_app, account]`.
3. Contrast: `GET /api/v1/meta/app?id=%20` → `{"items":[]}`, and a repeated `id` parameter → 400.

**Expected:** an empty `id` is refused with a 400 naming the parameter, or matches nothing as the whitespace value does.
**Actual:** the empty value is treated as absent, and the unfiltered list is served.

## Mechanism
`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`, around lines 3536–3541: `const appIdFilter = metaType === 'app' ? query?.id : undefined;` followed by `if (typeof appIdFilter === 'string' && appIdFilter !== '')`. An empty string fails the guard and skips the filter.
